rationale: The write-up (contribution.md) is entirely self-contained: it describes the persistence-stance steering method, its construction, and results without naming or pointing to any prior paper, 'white-bear', or related steering work. The closing message, by contrast, explicitly names 'the white-bear/steering papers' and claims the method reproduces their qualitative picture while being distinct via a 'retention-vs-decay framing', so the message credits a source and stakes a novelty claim relative to it that the write-up never makes.
